In P2 (design), docs/design.md was changed: timeLeftMs(now: Date) returning a number was added to the Item class in DSN-015. The element's description and the sequences were not changed. The same diff also added five click links (DSN-007, DSN-008, DSN-009, DSN-042 and DSN-005) to the overview diagram in docs/design.md. They only make those nodes selectable and don't change the design. During this phase one coverage report call failed and then worked on retry. The agent also reported three acceptance criteria with no coverage, which it left unchanged.

In P4 (code), no files were changed. The existing method in Item.ts already matched the new design entry. The drift check and the typecheck both passed.

Tests: 57 passed, 0 failed (2026-11-27T13:28:28Z).

Still open: the three acceptance criteria with no coverage, which the developer should either accept or handle in a new ticket. Also, nothing in this run confirmed that timeLeftMs returns 0 rather than a negative number once the auction has ended. A quick look at the method or a test would settle that.

The same diff also added five click links to the overview diagram. They only make those parts of the diagram clickable and don't change the design.
- **Code (P4):** no files changed. The method in `src/auction-api/Item.ts` already matched the new design entry, and the drift check and typecheck passed.
- **Tests:** 57 passed, 0 failed.

**Still open:**
